fact: On 16 January 2025 the tax directorate announced a one-month SYC@D pilot from 20 January 2025 in the Ouagadougou land registry offices, with the attribution and cession modules already working and production use since November 2024.
title: Burkina/ Dématérialisation des actes administratifs : La direction générale des Impôts lance l'application SYC@D pour une phase pilote d'un mois
